scripts.ci:install:pnpm: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm add -w yarn-tool lerna ynpx pnpm typescript ts-node tsx ts-jest jest @bluelovers/jest-config @bluelovers/tsconfig @yarn-tool/require-resolve
scripts.lerna:publish: pnpm run prepublishOnly:root && lerna publish && pnpm run postpublishOnly
scripts.lerna:publish:yes: pnpm run prepublishOnly:root && lerna publish --yes --bump patch && pnpm run postpublishOnly
scripts.lerna:publish:yes:major: node --run prepublishOnly:root && lerna publish --no-private --yes --bump major && pnpm run postpublishOnly
scripts.lerna:publish:yes:minor: node --run prepublishOnly:root && lerna publish --no-private --yes --bump minor && pnpm run postpublishOnly
scripts.lerna:publish:yes:patch: node --run prepublishOnly:root && lerna publish --no-private --yes --bump patch && pnpm run postpublishOnly
scripts.postpublishOnly:ws-root-changelog: ynpx ws-root-changelog & git add ./CHANGELOG.md & git commit ./CHANGELOG.md -m "chore(changelog): update changelog toc in workspaces root" & echo update changelog toc in workspaces root
scripts.ncu: pnpm run ncu:root && pnpm run ncu:ws
